designationHistory.indexText: Our History January 22, 1941 – A refuge was established within Havasu Lake National Wildlife Refuge as a breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife. 1977 – A large tract of land was purchased from The Nature Conservancy and incorporated into the refuge.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
